content.overview: Section 11 of the Hindu Marriage Act, 1955 declares a marriage null and void if it contravenes s. 5(i) (living spouse), s. 5(iv) (prohibited degrees) or s. 5(v) (sapinda relationship), unless custom governing both parties permits the latter two. The marriage is void ab initio; a decree of nullity is commonly sought for status and consequential reliefs. Children receive limited legitimacy under s. 16.
